sections.kicker: Prepared for Trópico by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Trópico has thirty years of curation. Its captions say beauty could be anything.
sections.keep: The line on the site: Diseño que permanece. It says what the house stands for in three words.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.what: The site holds the brand idea. The Instagram never repeats it.
pins.why: Design that lasts is a clear promise. The captions talk about beauty in general.
pins.how: Bring the headline into the bio and into the first line of every caption.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Instagram shoppers meet a lifestyle brand, not the house with a promise.

pins.what: Thirty years of selecting is the strongest proof, and the feed barely uses it.
pins.why: Few Lima furniture brands can say it. The grid shows no maker, no workshop and no year.
pins.how: Show the selecting: who chose it, where it was made, why it stayed.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Thirty years of authority reads as a showroom.

pins.quote: Hay una belleza que no necesita imponerse.
pins.what: Poetic captions fit any furniture brand.
pins.why: Texts about beauty that does not need to impose itself could sit under any sofa in Latin America.
pins.how: Write one fact per caption: the wood, the weave, the workshop.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: The look is polished and the voice is interchangeable.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Trópico. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Trópico's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
